subject: Re: Cerulean v6 quant rollout - throughput collapse & exec alert
messages:
From: Diane Kaplan <diane.kaplan@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:04 -0700
Subject: Sudden throughput collapse after v6 quant rollout

Mina —

We pushed the v6 quantized model to production at 08:30 this morning (controlled rollout). Within the first 20 minutes our request rate flattened while latency jumped and 5xx errors started to appear. P95 went from ~120ms to 1.2s; throughput dropped ~60%. Attached is a CSV with request-level metrics and a screenshot of the traces (cerulean_qprofile_metrics.csv, screenshot-p99-traces.png).

This is customer-critical: our onboarding sync loop is backing up and several clinics have already reported timeouts. Samir (CTO) has asked for an executive-level update and wants Redwood to prioritize.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) roll us back to v5 immediately, or (b) apply a quick fallback to the previous quant profile? If rollback requires approvals, please escalate.

Thanks,
Diane
Director, Platform Operations
Cerulean Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Diane Kaplan <diane.kaplan@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:28:17 -07:00
Subject: URGENT: Cerulean v6 quant rollout causing throughput collapse — coordinate rollback/fallback

Team —

Just received the report below from Cerulean. P95 increase / 5xx spike after the v6 quant profile went live. This looks like the KV cache path is under-optimized for the new quant layout (early hypothesis).

Immediate asks:
- Irene: can you pull the rollout traces and recent kernel selection logs for the v6 profile (last 90 minutes)? Prioritize P99 token latency and batching metrics.
- Ben: prepare a hotfix branch with a conservative quant profile (v6-lite) and a fallback that keeps v5 model weights but uses the v5 kernel path. Attach patch as proposed_fallback_patch.patch.
- Marissa & Rishi: I need an exec summary for Cerulean and an approval path to perform an emergency rollback if the quick fallback introduces regressions. Marissa — can you own customer comms?

We should aim to apply fallback within 60 minutes or rollback if not possible. I'll coordinate the runbook and keep Cerulean updated every 30 minutes.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Lead, Enterprise Success
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Diane Kaplan <diane.kaplan@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:03:41 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Cerulean v6 quant rollout causing throughput collapse — traces attached

On Wed, Mar 14, 2028 at 09:28 AM Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Just received the report below from Cerulean. P95 increase / 5xx spike after the v6 quant profile went live.

I've pulled the kernel selection logs and the runtime trace. Early read: the new int8 packing in v6 causes increased memory pressure on the KV cache for long-context sessions — we observe eviction thrashing on the NVMe-backed cache tier which stalls decoding and surfaces as elevated p99 and 5xx.

Attached a short extract in the internal run (link posted to team drive). Immediate mitigation options:
1) Short-term: force smaller batch windows for Cerulean's route (reduce batching to keep memory footprint stable).
2) Medium-term: deploy v6-lite with less aggressive packing (Ben is prepping patch).
3) Rollback to v5 if 1/2 cannot be tested safely within 60m.

I'll be on the bridge to validate metrics.

—Irene
Senior Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Diane Kaplan <diane.kaplan@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 11:10:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Cerulean v6 quant rollout causing throughput collapse — proposed patch

On Wed, Mar 14, 2028 at 10:03 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Early read: the new int8 packing in v6 causes increased memory pressure on the KV cache...

I've pushed a v6-lite branch to hotfix/v6-lite (internal). The patch reduces packing aggressiveness, disables chunked KV prefetch for this customer, and forces the legacy kernel selection path for sequences >1024 tokens. Patch stub: proposed_fallback_patch.patch.

I'll test on a canary node now; if green I'll stage to Cerulean's traffic slice. If that fails, we should be ready to rollback to v5 immediately — Marissa, can you surface the customer-facing rollback approval?

—Ben
Principal Software Engineer, Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Kaplan <diane.kaplan@ceruleanhealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 12:05:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Cerulean v6 quant rollout causing throughput collapse — customer update

Diane —

Thank you for flagging. Short update: our engineering team has identified the likely cause tied to the v6 quant packing. We're running a targeted v6-lite test on a canary and tracking p95/p99 and 5xx. We expect an initial mitigation update within 45 minutes.

If the canary is not green, we have approval to execute a rollback to v5 immediately; I will coordinate the timing with you to minimize disruption. Rishi and I will host an exec bridge at 2:00pm PT to provide a full incident summary for your CTO.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Diane Kaplan <diane.kaplan@ceruleanhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@ceruleanhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec bridge 2028-03-14 14:00 PT — Cerulean quant incident summary

Team / Cerulean execs —

Summary for the 2:00pm PT bridge: v6 quant rollout increased KV cache pressure for long-context sessions, causing eviction thrash and resulting in p95/p99 spikes and a wave of 5xx. Current status: v6-lite canary showing 85% of baseline throughput and p95 trending toward acceptable ranges; no rollback performed yet.

Action items for the bridge:
- Irene: present kernel selection logs and memory eviction timelines.
- Ben: present v6-lite changes and run-of-show for staged deployment.
- Marissa & Mina: share customer impact and suggested RTO/RPO.

If canary stabilizes we will complete staged fallback this evening; if not, we will rollback to v5 and coordinate cutover with Cerulean.

—Rishi
VP, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
